FR-001.title: Draw all text in the active brand's own colours, not the framework's stock text colours

FR-002.title: Define the raised surface tone for light mode as well as dark mode

FR-003.title: Guarantee a deployment supplying its own brand colour receives no default-brand values

FR-004.title: Define a named spacing scale on the four-unit grid

FR-005.title: Define a named corner-radius scale from square to fully rounded

FR-006.title: Define an elevation model expressing depth via surface tone, shadow for overlays only

FR-007.title: Define density and minimum target settings selected by touch vs pointer

FR-008.title: Define which type-hierarchy role each kind of text uses at each supported width

FR-009.title: Every token obtainable from the active theme; no direct references

FR-010.title: Spacing, radius, elevation, density and type roles identical across deployments

FR-011.title: Organise tokens so customisable and non-customisable sets are structurally separate

FR-012.title: Define every width-dependent measurement for all four supported widths

FR-013.title: Shared controls visibly adapt spacing and density between tablet and desktop widths

FR-014.title: Decide and record narrow-width values even though phone layouts are out of scope

FR-015.title: Define every shared control's appearance centrally

FR-016.title: Central appearance covers the full enumerated set of shared controls

FR-017.title: Screens must not restate a centrally-defined control's appearance

FR-018.title: Replace the two near-identical status indicators with a single shared control

FR-019.title: No screen or control specifies a typeface or text size directly

FR-020.title: Hold reference images for every shared control in four light/dark x width combinations

FR-021.title: Reference images exist and pass before any central appearance change

FR-022.title: Verify text colours meet the accessibility contrast threshold in both modes

FR-023.title: Report, not silently accept, a shared control with no reference image

FR-024.title: Controls fall back to sensible values when rendered outside the product theme

FR-025.title: Do not build phone-specific layout components in this feature

FR-026.title: Snap off-grid brand-guide measurements to the nearest step and raise with the brand owner

FR-027.title: Fail the build when any deployment's brand colour cannot meet contrast as a foreground

FR-028.title: Narrow the monospaced role to identifiers and timestamps; codes/SKUs stay body text
